## 🚀 Feature Description

### 💭 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

### ✨ Describe the solution you'd love to see
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. How should this feature work?

### 🔄 Alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📋 Additional Context

### 🎯 Use Cases
- Who would benefit from this feature?
- What scenarios would this feature be used in?

### 📎 Attachments
Add any screenshots, mockups, or diagrams that help explain your feature request.

### 🔗 Related Issues/PRs
Is this feature request related to any existing issues or pull requests?

---

**💡 Pro tip:** The more details you provide, the better we can understand and implement your idea!
